page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top with page number at top right. Main text in one column; marginal references ("Observ.", "Non", "obsf.", "N. obsf.") stand in the left margin beside the numbered precepts, with "ib." references at the right of the lines. Signature "Hh 3" at the foot.

main_text.p: Observ.454 Non addes legi sive scriptae sive per os traditae quae est ejus interpretatio. ib. 32
Observ.456 Non audies pseudoprophe tam qui prophetavit in nomine Idoli. ib. 3
Observ.457 Non amabis illum qui pellexit ad idololatriam. ib. 4
Observ.458 Sed semper hunc odio prosequere. ib. 4
Observ.459 Non liberabis hunc incitatorem. ib. 4
Observ.461 Non tacebit incitatus si nowerit causam contra incitantem. ib. 4
Observ.462 Non debes incitare Israeli tam contra Deum. ib. 11
Observ.463 Expendas oportet diligenter omnia testimonia. ib. 14
Non obs.464 Debes interficere homines depulsos & combures civitatem. ib. 15
Non obs.465 Non aedificabis civitatem ex qua depulsi sunt homines. ib. 16
N. obs.466 Non habebis usum de facultatibus civitatis depulsae. ib. 17

page.notes: Marginal references are partly worn and were read with some uncertainty; the signature "Hh 3" at the foot is a gathering mark. Some side marks such as "ib." numbers are partly illegible.
